answer: Treat each identity as an orchard that must bear real fruit: the agent binds itself to an encrypted personal-history vault of receipts, messages and work logs, and each epoch a random stranger quizzes it, answered only through zero-knowledge proofs that reveal nothing else. A violet thread runs through every proof, tying the vault to one identity. The pearl is the attacker's bill: fabricating a decade of consistent history per fake identity costs more than any sybil gains, since each quiz samples unpredictable corners of the vault and one inconsistent answer burns the identity's standing.
